The blood work and ultrasound are normal, and there is no pulmonary edema, so this does not appear to be a standard infection or heart failure. However, the chest X-ray shows an enlarged heart, and you still have rapid breathing and leg swelling. Do you have a history of congenital heart defects or cyanosis (blue skin) since birth?
